finding: A READY Vercel deployment object bound only to gitSource.sha is insufficient: another project or repository can share the same commit SHA. Immutable deployment evidence must independently match expected projectId, project name, GitHub repoId, ref, and commit SHA.

primary.title: Vercel REST API: Get a deployment by ID or URL

verification.environment: isolated local Node runtime using byte-identical pre-commit files

uncertainty: No authenticated Vercel deployment object was fetched in this slice.
The expected Vercel project ID must be supplied from a trusted configuration source, not inferred from the observed deployment.
Repository ref matching is intentionally strict and may require an explicit policy for pull-request refs.
falsification_route: Provide a documented Vercel response where projectId, name, gitSource.repoId, gitSource.ref, or gitSource.sha are unavailable to an authenticated project owner.
Execute the validator against a retained authenticated deployment object and compare with independent Vercel project metadata.
Demonstrate a legitimate deployment flow where strict ref equality produces a false rejection and define a narrower authenticated alternative.
